goal: Prevent compiler warnings (-Wundef) on platforms where std::system is missing by defining HAVE_SYSTEM as 0 rather than leaving it undefined.
agreement: Pushback against ad-hoc cmake macro changes without project-wide consistency (fanquake, maflcko).
Alternative suggested to check definedness at call sites instead (hebasto).

categories.name: build
why: P4 because it only suppresses a compiler warning on an experimental platform without affecting build integrity or supported platforms.

result.summary: Switches the CMake generation macro for HAVE_SYSTEM from #cmakedefine to #cmakedefine01 in bitcoin-build-config.h.in. This ensures HAVE_SYSTEM is always defined as either 0 or 1, avoiding -Wundef warnings when std::system is absent.
result.problem: When std::system is unavailable (such as during iOS builds), #cmakedefine leaves HAVE_SYSTEM undefined, which causes compiler warnings under -Wundef when checked with #if HAVE_SYSTEM.

open_concerns: fanquake objected to ad-hoc macro changes without clear justification.
hebasto suggested reverting the call site to #if defined(HAVE_SYSTEM).
maflcko suggested standardizing and linting build configuration macros project-wide rather than changing them individually.
resolved_concerns: Author dropped a simultaneous change to HAVE_FDATASYNC after discussion.
discussion.author_status: active; replied to initial comments and force-pushed to remove unrelated changes on 2026-08-19

agreement.reason: Maintainers pushed back against making ad-hoc changes to cmake macro conventions without a project-wide standard or linting, and no reviewer has supported the change.
evidence: fanquake: 'Please don't make random changes for no reason.'

Sjors: '@hebasto using #if defined(HAVE_SYSTEM) looks ugly imo, but it also risks someone using #if HAVE_SYSTEM accidentally.'

categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in, altering how CMake generates preprocessor definitions.
categories.rationale: P4 because this is a cosmetic warning cleanup for an unsupported platform configuration (building the kernel for iOS). It does not affect release integrity, supported platforms, or CI reliability.

result.card: This PR changes bitcoin-build-config.h.in to use #cmakedefine01 for HAVE_SYSTEM so the macro is always defined as 0 or 1. It resolves a -Wundef compiler warning when building for platforms lacking std::system (such as iOS). Reviewers pushed back against ad-hoc macro changes, suggesting either call-site checks with #if defined or a project-wide linted standard. No PRs depend on this.
